name: Pipeline (Pipes and Filters) Architecture
forces_resolved: High reusability of discrete transformation steps
Stream processing and sequential computational flow
Modularity and composability of processing filters
forces_unresolved: Complex error handling and partial pipeline recovery
Poor fit for complex multi-party interactive request-reply flows
applicability_conditions: Batch processing, ETL data transformations, media encoding pipelines
Compilers, document ingest engines, and scientific computing flows
anti_requisites: High-frequency interactive random access data mutation
Complex ACID distributed transactions across branching paths
